player_report_layout.note: Uses the registered FM27 27.1.0 schema-6 layout for build 27.1.1+2511875. Each report's embedded record-variant prefix is selected before decoding squad anchors, player metrics and record lengths; the target build itself remains unregistered.

upstream_registration.note: This local audit does not alter fmsave known_build or make the save build upstream-registered.

formal_fixture_schedule_coverage.note: This is schedule coverage, not a parser pass/fail check: FM27 saves retain reports for only some played fixtures.

retained_report_coverage.note: Coverage is compared only inside the dynamically discovered formal competition IDs. Native matches outside that scope (including friendlies/pre-season and unrecognized native-only competition IDs) are counted separately and are not treated as missing formal player-detail reports.

player_goal_reconciliation.method: sum goals decoded by raw_stats_from_probe_row() from every retained raw player record before identity and zero-minute filtering; normalized metrics are not used; missing raw goal values make that match incomplete
player_goal_reconciliation.note: Positive score/player-goal differences remain unattributed. An own goal is one possible explanation, but is not asserted without a separate match-event source. The audit reads raw player-record fields, includes rows later excluded from player appearances, and does not substitute normalized metrics or zero for missing raw values.

position_field_crosscheck.encoding: uint16 little-endian position mask; zero means no stored match position

rating_field_crosscheck.offset_selection: base offset plus embedded report-record variant distance-field displacement
rating_field_crosscheck.encoding: uint16 little-endian hundredths; /100; half-up to one decimal

limitations: Local evidence applies only to this checked save/build/schema and does not confer upstream registration.
FM27 build 27.1.1+2511875 remains unregistered in fmsave 0.14.3; the helper borrows the registered 27.1.0+2505117 schema-6 layout and selects each report's embedded record variant before decoding.
Structural and data reconciliation are not a substitute for semantic validation on other saves.
Player-goal differences against the fixture score remain explicitly unattributed until separately verified; they are not assigned to a player or automatically labelled own goals.
